title: Super Saiyan vs Super Saiyan God: Transformation Clash
script: This is Super Saiyan. This is Super Saiyan God. So what's the difference? Most fans think Super Saiyan God is just Super Saiyan 4. It's not. Super Saiyan multiplies mortal ki through intense emotional rage and physical stamina strain. But Super Saiyan God absorbs divine god ki through a ritual of pure-hearted Saiyans, granting godlike speed and self-healing. Super Saiyan burns mortal rage, while Super Saiyan God channel divine peace. Follow for more.
